Package com.lemarketjames.reports

package com.lemarketjames.reports
Report endpoints, all under /api/v1/reports/** and all for analysts only.

Every report here follows the rules in this module's README.md ("Rules for every report endpoint"): data comes only from the reporting_trades view, and a response holds aggregates only, never anything that identifies an individual client. Read them before adding an endpoint.
